title: Open Cadet
description: Your next high score starts here. Classic space pinball, rebuilt with original open assets.
overview: Open Cadet pairs the reverse-engineered SpaceCadetPinball engine with an original neon playfield and synthesized sounds. It recreates the familiar table’s behavior without distributing Microsoft’s PINBALL.DAT. The replacement artwork is intentionally different from the Windows original.
saveInstructions: High scores and table settings are saved locally. A ball in progress is not a portable save state.
limitations: Browser integration is undergoing verification.

verification.scope: Engine startup and rendering observed. Gameplay, audible audio, and save persistence remain unverified.

title: OpenTTD
description: Build a transport empire. Connect towns with trains, roads, ships, and aircraft.
overview: Lay a railway, schedule trains, and grow a transport network over decades. This build uses community replacement graphics and music, so no Transport Tycoon Deluxe files are needed. Start with a small map while learning the interface.
saveInstructions: Use the in-game Save menu, then export a backup from the player toolbar.
limitations: Large maps require more memory.
Network multiplayer is not provided by this site.
Music synthesis is not enabled in the current browser build.

verification.scope: Menu interaction, generated world, save dialog, and backup export observed. Save/reload and audible audio are not yet verified.

title: Freedoom
description: Play Freedoom Phase 2: original levels, artwork, and sounds running on an open Doom engine.
overview: Freedoom provides original artwork, levels, sounds, and music for open Doom engines. This player currently loads Phase 2 through Dwasm, using a software renderer. It does not require a commercial Doom WAD. Phase 1 is a separate campaign and is not selected by this player. The engine can also accept local WADs through the separate Doom entry.
saveInstructions: Press F2, select a slot, and confirm its name to save. Use F3 to load it. Local save/reload and toolbar backup export/import passed the September 19 in-app Chromium test. Export a backup before clearing browser storage.
limitations: Browser integration is undergoing verification.

verification.scope: September 19 live test: level start, keyboard firing, campaign save, reload after a fresh page load, and exported-backup import verified. Mouse capture, audible audio, and a complete playthrough remain unverified.

title: OpenTyrian
description: A vertical shooter with branching routes, ship upgrades, and a galaxy worth saving.
overview: OpenTyrian recreates the Tyrian 2.1 engine, using the freeware release of the original data. Campaign progress includes your ship equipment and upgrades. This is the classic Tyrian content, not a claim to include every Tyrian 2000 addition.
assetLicense: Tyrian 2.1 freeware; original assets retain their license
saveInstructions: Between missions, choose Options, then Save, select an empty slot, type a name, and press Enter. Export a backup from the player toolbar before closing. Save-file export was tested; in-game reload remains under investigation.
limitations: Intermittent black screen during menu transitions in the tested in-app Chromium browser; save/reload verification remains incomplete.

verification.scope: Live test reached episode selection, the ship menu, first mission, and a named save slot. Backup contained tyrian.sav and configuration files, including after restart. A black screen during a later menu transition blocked in-game reload verification. Audible audio and a completed level remain unverified.
